summary: FASE 6 — Módulo Clientes: Full backend + frontend testing. All 26 backend pytest cases passing covering CRUD, RBAC (super_admin OK, client_admin/compliance 403), signed JWT links (verify + consume + no-reuse), per-client users (invite/patch/revoke), API keys plaintext-once (GET excludes plaintext/secret_hash, rotate returns new plaintext), webhooks (create returns secret once, GET hides secret, real httpbin delivery with HMAC X-Prosper-Signature returning http_code=200, reveal-secret), outbound emails preview_only mode with text/html preview endpoint, and audit-log entries. Frontend: client listing (25 rows, search, 3 filter groups, '+Nuevo cliente' btn) loads cleanly. Detail page renders 9 tabs (Información, Usuarios, KYB Docs, API Keys, Webhooks, Posiciones, Transacciones, Compliance, Audit Log) + 4 header buttons. KYB link button copies signed token to clipboard. New-client form has 20 data-testid fields and submit disabled until validation passes. Audit log timeline shows clients.create/patch/pause/reactivate/link.* with expandable meta JSON. Webhooks tab shows per-row reveal/test/expand/delete testids. Backend success_rate: 100% (26/26). Frontend success_rate: ~95% (one design issue: native browser date picker used instead of shadcn Calendar).

issues: FECHA ESTIMADA DE INICIO uses native HTML date input (mm/dd/yyyy browser picker) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component — inconsistent with the rest of the design system
Tier, Tipo, País, Ambiente fields use native <select> dropdowns instead of shadcn Select component (minor visual inconsistency)

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace native date input on /admin/clients/new with a shadcn Calendar / DatePicker component for visual consistency.
(Optional polish) Replace native <select> elements (country, type, env, tier) with shadcn Select for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Security regression test PASSING: POST /api/v1/admin/clients/{org}/api-keys returns 'plaintext' + warning; subsequent GET excludes both 'plaintext' and 'secret_hash' (verified across all items). Same pattern holds for webhooks (POST returns 'secret', GET hides it). This is the most important invariant in this phase and it holds.
Signed JWT consume is single-use: second attempt returns 401 'Link already used or expired' as expected — replay protection works.
RBAC consistently enforced across all write endpoints (POST/PATCH/pause/reactivate): client_admin → 403. compliance_officer → 403 on create.
Webhook test delivery to https://httpbin.org/anything returns 200 and the delivery log persists the http_code correctly — signed HMAC header pipeline works end-to-end.

RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally empty → all outbound emails saved with status='preview_only' and full HTML retrievable via /emails/{id}/preview (Content-Type: text/html). MOCKED INTEGRATION confirmed working as designed.
Code quality: admin_clients router cleanly split into 7 files (crud/users/links/api_keys/webhooks/emails/_deps). Good separation of concerns.
seed_data_creation: Test creates org with tax_id=TEST-<uuid> and legal_name=TEST_Corp_<uuid> SA each module-scoped fixture run. Cleanup not automated — existing test orgs visible in listing as TEST_Corp_* (no impact, identifiable by TEST_ prefix).
mocked_integrations_confirmed: httpbin.org/anything used as real webhook target — returns 200 echoing payload, suitable for delivery log verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: FASE 6 backend is solid. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase6_clients.py runs in ~5s and is safe to re-execute (TEST_ prefixed data). PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var defaults to the preview host. If new event types are added to webhooks, the available_events list at GET /api/v1/admin/clients/{org}/webhooks is the source of truth. For pytest: `pytest backend/tests/test_phase6_clients.py -v`. RBAC test session uses dev-login cookies — no MFA needed.
